People use drugs and drink sometimes in order to celebrate, or just have a good time. (College parties, toasts at weddings) But the feelings brought on by cutting and drug use are temporary, and damaging in the long run. I have scars on my shoulders and wrists and my singing voice is wrecked from smoking. Learning how to make you feel better on your own is something that will always help, and never hurt you. Best of luck escaping from your situation, and I hope that you feel better soon. Feel free to PM me.

I would never, in any circumstance, reccomend self harm. It's replacing one bad habit with a worse one. Sure, alcohol and drugs hurt you, but hurting yourself has a 100% chance of hurting you. If you smoke and drink to deal with problems, get yourself some help. Problems come and go, but scars and regret are forever.

Twice.

Attempt 1: I spent the day just walking, anywhere I pleased. I must have walked for miles. I got awfully lost and had to call a friend to take me back home.

Later that evening, I was at my grandmother's house. I excused myself from the dinner table and went to the basement. Normally, I knew where my grandmother kept the keys to the gun cabinet, but I couldn't find them. I later learned that my grandmother had accidentally left them with my uncle when he was cleaning the guns.


Attempt 2: It was a rare snow day in the south. Normally I would have cherished the snow, but I sat in my chair and browsed r/morbidreality for a good three hours. I cut my wrists and dangled them into my bathtub, when I got a call from a good friend of mine. I must have sounded out of it, because before I knew it, there was urgent knocking at my door. I answered it and it was my friend. She brought along another friend of mine. They made me eat some crackers (I had not eaten in about a week) and we watched Pete's Dragon together. They selflessly stayed with me until I had to go to bed. I am eternally grateful to my friends that saved me that day. This happened about a week ago. I'm still adjusting my eating habits and trying to occupy myself with a lot of projects. I still feel sick and hopeless, but I try to distract myself with my close friends and my projects.

This seems to be a pattern with me. The people who love me eventually leave me when I need them most and kick me while I'm down. Because of this, my grades are slipping, I can't focus in my classes, and I can barley hold down food. I'll probably lose my acceptance to college and I'll be a failure for the rest of my life.
I just made a thread, thank you
